title: Skeleton Rigging Joint Hierarchy Viewer with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive skeleton rigging joint hierarchy viewer with full time control. The scene must meet ALL of the following requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e). Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8), looking at origin.
- Ambient light (0x404060, intensity 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at (5, 10, 5).
- Add a subtle grid helper (size 10, divisions 10, color 0x333355) on the ground plane.
- OrbitControls for camera manipulation.

## Skeleton Hierarchy
- Build a humanoid skeleton hierarchy using Three.js Bone objects with the following structure:
  - Root (hip) at (0, 1, 0)
    - Spine at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
      - Chest at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
        - Head at relative (0, 0.4, 0)
        - LeftShoulder at relative (-0.3, 0.3, 0)
          - LeftArm at relative (-0.5, 0, 0)
            - LeftHand at relative (-0.4, 0, 0)
        - RightShoulder at relative (0.3, 0.3, 0)
          - RightArm at relative (0.5, 0, 0)
            - RightHand at relative (0.4, 0, 0)
    - LeftHip at relative (-0.2, 0, 0)
      - LeftLeg at relative (0, -0.5, 0)
        - LeftFoot at relative (0, -0.5, 0)
    - RightHip at relative (0.2, 0, 0)
      - RightLeg at relative (0, -0.5, 0)
        - RightFoot at relative (0, -0.5, 0)
- Total: 15 bones.
- Visualize each joint as a small sphere (radius 0.06, 0x00ff88) and each bone connection as a cylinder/line (0x00aa66) between parent and child joints.
- The root bone should be part of a Skeleton object attached to a SkinnedMesh (can be a simple invisible mesh or a basic capsule-based body).

## Joint Selection
- Clicking on a joint sphere via raycasting selects it. The selected joint turns yellow (0xffff00) and all others revert to green (0x00ff88).
- A DOM panel (top-right, id='joint-info') displays: joint name, world position (x,y,z rounded to 2 decimals), current local rotation (Euler degrees rounded to 1 decimal), and depth in hierarchy (root=0).

## Animation System
- Implement a simple procedural wave animation: a sinusoidal wave that propagates down the arms. Specifically:
  - LeftShoulder and RightShoulder rotate on Z-axis: sin(time * speed) * amplitude
  - LeftArm and RightArm rotate on Z-axis: sin(time * speed + 0.5) * amplitude * 1.2
  - LeftHand and RightHand rotate on Z-axis: sin(time * speed + 1.0) * amplitude * 0.8
  - Default amplitude = 0.5 radians, default speed = 2.0
- The animation should also include a subtle breathing motion on the Spine: sin(time * 1.5) * 0.05 on the Y scale.

## Time Control
- A DOM control bar at the bottom (id='time-controls') with:
  - Play/Pause button (id='btn-play-pause'), toggles animation. Starts paused.
  - Speed slider (id='slider-speed', range 0.1 to 5.0, step 0.1, default 2.0)
  - Amplitude slider (id='slider-amplitude', range 0.1 to 1.5, step 0.1, default 0.5)
  - A time scrubber (id='slider-time', range 0 to 100, step 0.1) that controls the animation time directly when paused. When playing, it updates to reflect current time (mod 100).
  - A reset button (id='btn-reset') that resets time to 0, pauses, resets speed to 2.0, amplitude to 0.5, deselects any joint, and resets all bone rotations to identity.
  - Current time display (id='time-display') showing time with 2 decimal places.

## Hierarchy Tree View
- A collapsible DOM tree (id='hierarchy-tree') on the left side showing the bone hierarchy as nested <ul>/<li> elements.
- Each bone name is clickable (class='tree-node', data-bone-name attribute) and selects that joint (same as clicking the 3D sphere).
- The currently selected joint is highlighted in the tree with class 'selected'.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - boneCount: total number of bones (15)
  - selectedJoint: name of selected joint or null
  - isPlaying: boolean
  - currentTime: float, the animation time
  - speed: float, current speed
  - amplitude: float, current amplitude
  - jointWorldPositions: object mapping bone name to {x, y, z} world positions
  - jointLocalRotations: object mapping bone name to {x, y, z} Euler rotations in degrees
  - hierarchyDepths: object mapping bone name to depth integer (Root=0, Spine=1, etc.)
  - maxDepth: integer, the maximum depth in the hierarchy
  - treeNodeCount: number of nodes in the DOM hierarchy tree
  - selectedTreeNode: name shown as selected in tree or null
  - spineScaleY: current Y scale of the Spine bone

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Joint world positions must be computed from the skeleton hierarchy chain (parent transforms propagate to children). All rotations must be NaN-free. The wave animation phase offset must propagate correctly down the arm chain (shoulder -> arm -> hand). Spine breathing scale must stay within [0.95, 1.05]. Time must advance monotonically when playing and remain constant when paused.
